summary_rationale: SK hynix has built a genuine technological and packaging moat in High Bandwidth Memory (50%-58% HBM revenue share, ~70% initial HBM4 allocations, Advanced MR-MUF thermal yield edge, and >50% LTA coverage for 2027-2028 capacity), driving FY2025 revenue to KRW 97.15T (48.6% op. margin), Q3 2026 revenue to KRW 104.62T (79.7% op. margin), ROIC of 71.84%, and a net-cash balance sheet. Nevertheless, the business remains structurally capital-intensive (~30% of peak revenue reinvested in capex) and exposed to historical memory cyclicality (FY2023 operating loss of -KRW 7.73T), customer concentration in AI accelerators, Samsung/Micron HBM4 catch-up and hybrid-bonding transitions, and U.S. export-control bottlenecks at its Wuxi and Dalian fabs in China. It therefore earns CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL quality with PASS operational KPIs rather than an unconditional compounder label.
